q: THE ONLY THING WE HAVE TO FEAR IS FEAR ITSELF.
ASK NOT WHAT YOUR COUNTRY CAN DO FOR YOU. ASK WHAT YOU CAN DO FOR YOUR COUNTRY.
NEVER IN THE FIELD OF HUMAN CONFLICT WAS SO MUCH OWED BY SO MANY TO SO FEW.
WE SHALL DEFEND OUR ISLAND, WHATEVER THE COST MAY BE.
GIVE ME LIBERTY, OR GIVE ME DEATH.
THE HISTORY OF ALL HITHERTO EXISTING SOCIETY IS THE HISTORY OF CLASS STRUGGLES.
IT IS NOT FROM THE BENEVOLENCE OF THE BUTCHER, THE BREWER, OR THE BAKER THAT WE EXPECT OUR DINNER, BUT FROM THEIR REGARD TO THEIR OWN INTEREST.
IF I HAVE SEEN FURTHER, IT IS BY STANDING ON THE SHOULDERS OF GIANTS.
INJUSTICE ANYWHERE IS A THREAT TO JUSTICE EVERYWHERE.
THE ARC OF THE MORAL UNIVERSE IS LONG, BUT IT BENDS TOWARD JUSTICE.
IN THIS WORLD NOTHING CAN BE SAID TO BE CERTAIN, EXCEPT DEATH AND TAXES.
via: a letter to Jean-Baptiste Le Roy

q: I NEVER EXPECT TO SEE A PERFECT WORK FROM AN IMPERFECT MAN.
THESE ARE THE TIMES THAT TRY MEN’S SOULS.
IF MEN WERE ANGELS, NO GOVERNMENT WOULD BE NECESSARY.
AMBITION MUST BE MADE TO COUNTERACT AMBITION.
MAN IS BORN FREE, AND EVERYWHERE HE IS IN CHAINS.
EVERYONE SEES WHAT YOU APPEAR TO BE; FEW EXPERIENCE WHAT YOU REALLY ARE.
THE STRONG DO WHAT THEY CAN AND THE WEAK SUFFER WHAT THEY MUST.
A HOUSE DIVIDED AGAINST ITSELF CANNOT STAND.
FOUR SCORE AND SEVEN YEARS AGO OUR FATHERS BROUGHT FORTH UPON THIS CONTINENT A NEW NATION.
IF THERE IS NO STRUGGLE THERE IS NO PROGRESS.
THE PROBLEM OF THE TWENTIETH CENTURY IS THE PROBLEM OF THE COLOR LINE.
THE UNEXAMINED LIFE IS NOT WORTH LIVING.
EVERY GUN THAT IS MADE, EVERY WARSHIP LAUNCHED, SIGNIFIES A THEFT FROM THOSE WHO HUNGER.
MR. GORBACHEV, TEAR DOWN THIS WALL.
I THINK, THEREFORE I AM.
ALL WARFARE IS BASED ON DECEPTION.
GOVERNMENT OF THE PEOPLE, BY THE PEOPLE, FOR THE PEOPLE, SHALL NOT PERISH FROM THE EARTH.
I HAVE NOTHING TO OFFER BUT BLOOD, TOIL, TEARS AND SWEAT.
I CANNOT LIVE WITHOUT BOOKS.
I ONLY REGRET THAT I HAVE BUT ONE LIFE TO LOSE FOR MY COUNTRY.
GIVE ME A PLACE TO STAND, AND I SHALL MOVE THE EARTH.
ANY MAN’S DEATH DIMINISHES ME, BECAUSE I AM INVOLVED IN MANKIND.
IMAGINATION IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN KNOWLEDGE.
SPEAK SOFTLY AND CARRY A BIG STICK; YOU WILL GO FAR.
WE CHOOSE TO GO TO THE MOON IN THIS DECADE AND DO THE OTHER THINGS, NOT BECAUSE THEY ARE EASY, BUT BECAUSE THEY ARE HARD.
COWARDS DIE MANY TIMES BEFORE THEIR DEATHS; THE VALIANT NEVER TASTE OF DEATH BUT ONCE.
WHEN A MAN IS TIRED OF LONDON, HE IS TIRED OF LIFE.
I MUST STUDY POLITICS AND WAR THAT MY SONS MAY HAVE LIBERTY TO STUDY MATHEMATICS AND PHILOSOPHY.
I HAVE SWORN UPON THE ALTAR OF GOD ETERNAL HOSTILITY AGAINST EVERY FORM OF TYRANNY OVER THE MIND OF MAN.
NO MAN IS ABOVE THE LAW AND NO MAN IS BELOW IT.
THE CREDIT BELONGS TO THE MAN WHO IS ACTUALLY IN THE ARENA, WHOSE FACE IS MARRED BY DUST AND SWEAT AND BLOOD.
WITH MALICE TOWARD NONE, WITH CHARITY FOR ALL.
THE BALLOT IS STRONGER THAN THE BULLET.
THE SUMMER SOLDIER AND THE SUNSHINE PATRIOT WILL, IN THIS CRISIS, SHRINK FROM THE SERVICE OF THEIR COUNTRY.
WE ARE NOT MAKERS OF HISTORY; WE ARE MADE BY HISTORY.
IN THE BEGINNING THE UNIVERSE WAS CREATED. THIS HAS MADE A LOT OF PEOPLE VERY ANGRY AND BEEN WIDELY REGARDED AS A BAD MOVE.
via: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

q: ENERGY AND PERSISTENCE CONQUER ALL THINGS.
SCIENCE IS THE GREAT ANTIDOTE TO THE POISON OF ENTHUSIASM AND SUPERSTITION.
IF YOU WANT TO TELL PEOPLE THE TRUTH, MAKE THEM LAUGH, OTHERWISE THEY’LL KILL YOU.
COURAGE IS GRACE UNDER PRESSURE.
NOT ALL THOSE WHO WANDER ARE LOST.
WHOSOEVER IS DELIGHTED IN SOLITUDE IS EITHER A WILD BEAST OR A GOD.
I CANNOT AND WILL NOT CUT MY CONSCIENCE TO FIT THIS YEAR’S FASHIONS.
via: a statement to the House committee

q: THAT’S ONE SMALL STEP FOR MAN, ONE GIANT LEAP FOR MANKIND.
THE REPORT OF MY DEATH IS AN EXAGGERATION.
A MAN WHO DARES TO WASTE ONE HOUR OF TIME HAS NOT DISCOVERED THE VALUE OF LIFE.
EDUCATION IS THE MOST POWERFUL WEAPON WHICH YOU CAN USE TO CHANGE THE WORLD.
THE WHOLE PROBLEM WITH THE WORLD IS THAT FOOLS AND FANATICS ARE ALWAYS SO CERTAIN OF THEMSELVES, AND WISER PEOPLE SO FULL OF DOUBTS.
THE ONLY TIRED I WAS, WAS TIRED OF GIVING IN.
ALL ANIMALS ARE EQUAL, BUT SOME ANIMALS ARE MORE EQUAL THAN OTHERS.
IT IS A TRUTH UNIVERSALLY ACKNOWLEDGED, THAT A SINGLE MAN IN POSSESSION OF A GOOD FORTUNE, MUST BE IN WANT OF A WIFE.
I HAVE A DREAM THAT MY FOUR LITTLE CHILDREN WILL ONE DAY LIVE IN A NATION WHERE THEY WILL NOT BE JUDGED BY THE COLOR OF THEIR SKIN BUT BY THE CONTENT OF THEIR CHARACTER.
FLOAT LIKE A BUTTERFLY, STING LIKE A BEE.
THERE IS NO SUBSTITUTE FOR HARD WORK.
THE WEAK CAN NEVER FORGIVE. FORGIVENESS IS THE ATTRIBUTE OF THE STRONG.
LIFE IS WHAT HAPPENS TO YOU WHILE YOU’RE BUSY MAKING OTHER PLANS.
EDUCATION IS THE PASSPORT TO THE FUTURE, FOR TOMORROW BELONGS TO THOSE WHO PREPARE FOR IT TODAY.
I CAME, I SAW, I CONQUERED.
WELL DONE IS BETTER THAN WELL SAID.
I CAN RESIST EVERYTHING EXCEPT TEMPTATION.
HOPE IS THE THING WITH FEATHERS.
via: a poem published after her death

q: TWO ROADS DIVERGED IN A WOOD, AND I TOOK THE ONE LESS TRAVELED BY.
FAILURE IS IMPOSSIBLE.
THE PEOPLE WHO ARE CRAZY ENOUGH TO THINK THEY CAN CHANGE THE WORLD ARE THE ONES WHO DO.
LIFE IS EITHER A DARING ADVENTURE OR NOTHING.
DO WHAT YOU FEEL IN YOUR HEART TO BE RIGHT, FOR YOU’LL BE CRITICIZED ANYWAY.
THE SOUL BECOMES DYED WITH THE COLOR OF ITS THOUGHTS.
